mapper.select: select la.id, la.start_date, la.end_date, la.total_amount, la.payment_type_id, la.status booking_status, la.source_type, ai.name store_name, ri.seat_code, gi.name, gi.url from booking_order la left join study_store ai on la.store_id = ai.id and ai.is_deleted = 0 left join seat ri on la.seat_id = ri.id and ri.is_deleted = 0 left join graph_info gi on gi.item_type = 2 and gi.item_id = ri.id and gi.is_deleted = 0 where la.is_deleted = 0 and la.phone = #{phone}
